scripts.docker:homolog:ngrok: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.local-homolog.yml --profile ngrok up -d ngrok
scripts.docker:homolog:health: node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:3054/api/health', r => { let body = ''; r.on('data', c => body += c); r.on('end', () => { console.log(body); process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1); }); }).on('error', e => { console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.docker:homolog:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.local-homolog.yml exec backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:homolog:migrate:status: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.local-homolog.yml exec backend npx prisma migrate status
scripts.docker:homolog:bootstrap-admin: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.local-homolog.yml exec backend npm run prisma:bootstrap-admin
scripts.docker:homolog:check-clean: docker compose --env-file .env.docker -f docker-compose.local-homolog.yml exec backend npm run production:check-clean
